# All Services All Seasons, LLC

> Owner-operated handyman, renovation and property maintenance company based in Lancaster, Pennsylvania. One call covers every season and every size of job, for homes and businesses.

## Facts

- Name: All Services All Seasons, LLC
- Owner: Eric J. Totten, owner operator
- Established: 2021. Family owned.
- Phone (call or text): (717) 459-3552
- Email: allservicesllc21@gmail.com
- Mailing address: PO Box 6007, Lancaster, PA 17607
- Service-area business based in Lancaster, PA. No storefront.
- Credentials: Fully insured. Registered with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, PA#169611. Workers' compensation coverage.
- Tagline: Services you can count on year-round.

## Services

Contract maintenance, Seasonal clean ups, Renovations, Handyman services, Floor installation, Roofing, Plumbing, Electrical repairs, Mulching, Mowing, Weeding, Pruning foliage, Snow removal, Leaf and debris removal, Power washing, and more.

Snow removal covers shoveling sidewalks and driveways, snow blowers and ice melt.

## Service area

Based in Lancaster, PA. Neighbors recommend the business in Lancaster, Lititz, Mount Joy, Columbia, Manheim, Mountville, Landisville, East Petersburg, Millersville, Willow Street, Strasburg, Ephrata, Marietta and Quarryville.
